name: aryan-electronics
description: Aryan Electronics - Electronics product aggregation and discovery platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: cross-env CI=true npm --prefix server test && cross-env CI=true npm --prefix client test

author: Aryan Electronics Team
